author: reek
body: Two punctual functions that recurse through each other: ping calls pong, pong calls ping. Neither is self-recursive, so the per-def CDX6005 scan passes each in isolation, yet the pair has unbounded execution. The call-graph cycle check must reject at least one of them with CDX6005. A three-hop cycle (a -> b -> c -> a) is included to exercise the transitive reach walk beyond a single hop.
